locator.section: RG 480–481, 511 d/i, 513–514; Ordo Missae rubric and chant formula after the secrets

entries.claim: The final secret has an audible Per omnia saecula saeculorum followed by the response Amen. Collects and postcommunions are priestly orations with a separate response. These rules determine the modeled boundaries, not the completeness of a date-specific commemoration inventory.

The prescribed Father-directed conclusion supplies the expansion from Per Dominum nostrum through per omnia saecula saeculorum (w011–w031), while the proper page prints only Per Dominum. Reader accents and the house tuum: Qui punctuation and capitalization are supplied separately.

The cited proper page prints the ten-word prayer body (w001–w010) and the abbreviated Per Dominum cue. The full conclusion is supplied separately from Rubricae generales 115 a, with declared house accidentals.
